name: Shou
source:
A newbie at the CSF.

Shou is not so cheerful, but not so gloomy either. Usually he talks to other people normally, but he doesn't communicate deeply. In other words, he doesn't pry into other people's personal lives and doesn't let others do the same to him. He doesn't remember what his life was like before he became a rebel. Because of that he isn't confident in himself.
